free_tier.stated: 10 GB free forever on the Koofr Free plan. The lifetime plan is a separate paid 1 TB plan sold through StackSocial.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-file size limit ('Unlimited file size').

retention.stated: Deleted files are retained for 7 days on the Free plan and 30 days on paid plans.

egress.terms: Daily public transfer limit: 50 GB on Free, 200 GB on Briefcase plans, 1 TB on Suitcase plans, 4 TB on Crate plans.

tooling: Web and mobile apps, a desktop app and WebDAV; external Dropbox, OneDrive and Google Drive accounts can be connected.

limits.value: Free 10 GB; paid plans from 10 GB to 5 TB are priced, '10 TB and up' has no listed price

limits_note: The 1 TB lifetime plan was listed at $199.99 on StackSocial on 2026-10-17 (reported by a third party, who also lists $119.97 to $159.97 during promotions); the StackSocial page captured shows no price.

identity_cost.detail: The lifetime SKU is only available to new users, and its code must be redeemed within 30 days of purchase.

reliability_note: The lifetime SKU is 1 TB only and is sold through a reseller; Koofr's own site lists yearly subscriptions only, with 5 TB at 35 EUR /mo and '10 TB and up' unpriced.
confidence_note: documented: the free allowance, yearly-only billing, plan prices, the '10 TB and up' tier with no price, file size, deleted-file retention and the daily public transfer limit are quoted from the vendor page https://koofr.eu/pricing/ read on 2026-11-03; WebDAV access and the new-users-only lifetime SKU are quoted from https://www.stacksocial.com/sales/koofr-cloud-storage-lifetime-subscription-1-tb; the lifetime price is reported by https://www.dealkeep.io/blog/koofr-lifetime-deal, a third party, and the StackSocial page shows no price
